title_zh: 上限与筛子：卡住你的不是能力不够
title_en: Ceilings and Filters: What's Stopping You Isn't Ability
desc_zh: AI 订阅要设上限、接单要设上限、报价要认买方留出的区间；而纸面规则要到流程末端才生效——本周商业情报。
desc_en: Cap your AI subscriptions, cap the work you take on, and price to the band your buyer left open — and the paper rules that filter you only bite at the very end. This week's business intelligence.
